$comment: Vendored, unchanged except this comment, from the game environment's published GameTask schema (backend/app/factory/game_env/tasks.schema.json at commit 854a4fe3, 2026-10-19, branch feat/game-env-probe-checks; the probe check kind from bfd46540; identical to tasks.schema_text() run from that commit). Update it from there; tools/validate-game.py checks every task in a game repo's Tasks/ and in a dataset against it.

ActionsJudge.description:
A reviewer's question over what the agent did, from its own trace: each tool call in order (the tool, its
arguments and what it returned, cut), whether it worked, and which made a checkpoint; never the agent's reasoning
or messages. How the game was made counts beside the game itself (the owner, 2026-10-14: grade "based on agent
actions, and the final build").
ActionsJudge.title: ActionsJudge

AssetMeasure.description:
The project as saved, read in a headless editor pass: an asset's property (`asset` + prop:<path>), or actors
of a map (`map` + `select`).
AssetMeasure.title: AssetMeasure

AtCamera.description: The player's camera, `forward` cm along its view.
AtCamera.title: AtCamera

AtXYZ.description: A fixed point in the world (cm).
AtXYZ.title: AtXYZ

Axis.description: An axis event (MouseX, MouseY, Gamepad_LeftX) with its value, e.g. mouse look.
Axis.title: Axis

Boot.description: The game starts (headless, rendering offscreen) and runs `seconds` with no crash and no fatal error in its log.
Boot.title: Boot

Calibrate.description: Threshold s + f * (r - s): the start (s) and the developers' fix (r) measured in the grading environment.
Calibrate.title: Calibrate

Click.description: A click on the first visible button widget of that name or class, as a player would.
Click.title: Click

CodeJudge.description:
A code reviewer's question over the run's own change (its diff from the start, text files) beside the game's
real change for the same problem (the seed's `reference`, a bug's fix from the game's history), which the agent
never sees.
CodeJudge.title: CodeJudge

ComponentSelect.description:
Registered components of a class (NiagaraComponent, DecalComponent, AudioComponent), optionally of an owner
actor the `owner` select matches, and near a point.
ComponentSelect.title: ComponentSelect

Cursor.description: The mouse cursor moved to a viewport point (fractions 0-1); a following LeftMouseButton press clicks there.
Cursor.title: Cursor

FileExists.description: At least `min_count` project files match `glob` (relative to the project; e.g. Content/Maps/*.umap).
FileExists.title: FileExists

Judge.description:
The game judge's question over evidence the grader takes itself (screenshots and gameplay frames of a scripted
play, and the brief), item by item; never the agent's own words. `before`: the grader also plays the game as it
was at the start, and the judge compares (a seeded task that changes how the game looks or plays). `route`: a
project file in which the agent leaves inputs that play its game through (the probe's [{t, key, press}], e.g.
Tests/win_route.json); the grader plays it in its own clean copy as one more play, and the judge is told when
the file is missing or isn't a route.
Judge.title: Judge

Key.description: A key pressed or released (Unreal key names: W, SpaceBar, LeftMouseButton).
Key.title: Key

LogAbsent.description: No line of the game's log during a boot matches `pattern` (a regular expression).
LogAbsent.title: LogAbsent

LogMeasure.description: Lines of the play's game log matching `pattern`.
LogMeasure.title: LogMeasure

Package.description: A Development package builds, and the packaged game boots.
Package.title: Package

Probe.description:
A deterministic check (probes.md): `measure` taken where `play` says, reduced to one number, compared with
`expect`. `describe` is the assertion in plain English, shown in the grade.
Probe.title: Probe

Seed.description:
Where a seeded task starts: one of the studio's games at `commit`. `game` is its slug in the games catalog
(games.json: its repository, project and mirror), the folder under the machine's games root on the studio's PC.
`reference`: a later commit of that game whose change solves the task (a bug's fix), for the code judge only.
`history`: which history the two commits are from (datasets.py): "private", the game's own repository (its clone,
GitHub, the mirror), or "dataset", the rewritten history a layout v1.3 Dataset.zip delivers (History/), whose
commit ids differ; the game's commit map translates either way (datasets.seed_in).
Seed.title: Seed

Select.description:
Actors that match every key given: `class` (the actor's class or a parent, without prefix letters; a Blueprint
class by its asset name, BP_Wall_C), `tag` (an actor tag), `name` (a wildcard on its name or label), `near`
(within `radius` cm of a point), `player` (the player pawn).
Select.title: Select

StartPlus.description: Threshold s + d: the start (s) measured in the grading environment (a task with no developers' fix).
StartPlus.title: StartPlus

StartTimes.description: Threshold s * f: the start (s) measured in the grading environment (a task with no developers' fix).
StartTimes.title: StartTimes

TaskPlay.description:
A task-defined scripted play: `inputs` (keys, axes, widget clicks) sent at their times during `seconds`; its
own `map` (with URL options) instead of the task's play_map, `args` on its command line (game flags, -Name or
-Name=value, but never the grader's own: DENIED_ARGS, -GameEnv*), and samples every `every` seconds (default
0.5).
TaskPlay.title: TaskPlay

Teleport.description: The player pawn placed at `teleport` (cm) facing `yaw`: the grader's own way to reach a test spot.
Teleport.title: Teleport

TraceMeasure.description: A fact of the agent's own trace (never gating).
TraceMeasure.title: TraceMeasure

Value.description: A literal threshold, for facts that don't depend on the scene (counts, booleans).
Value.title: Value

WidgetSelect.description:
Widgets on screen: UMG widgets in the viewport by their class (WBP_HUD_C, TextBlock) and/or name, or Slate
widgets under the game viewport by their type (`slate`: STextBlock, SImage, a game's own S... type); `text`: a
regular expression the widget's text must match.
WidgetSelect.title: WidgetSelect
